cellguard.title: Excluded Towers
cellguard.empty_tips: No towers are excluded. The modem may use any tower it can reach.
cellguard.intro_tips: Excluded towers are never locked onto. When the modem lands on one, it moves to the strongest tower that is not excluded.
cellguard.key_tips: A PCI is enough. Add the frequency to exclude one carrier rather than every cell with that PCI.
cellguard.unavailable_tips: Tower exclusion is not installed on this firmware.
cellguard.observing_note: The daemon is watching the cell in use but changing nothing. Build the list here, then enable exclusion in the cellular settings.
cellguard.no_serving_tips: The tower in use is not known yet. Wait a few seconds for the next reading and try again.
cellguard.already_excluded: That tower is already on the list.
cellguard.other_sim_tips: このSIMはデータ通信に使われていません。タワーの除外は使用中のSIMに従うため、そちらに切り替えてから除外してください。
